units.source_text: 住持微胖，当然脸上已刻上皱纹，连一道道皱纹的深处也洗得于干净净。

en.t: The abbot was somewhat plump, and of course wrinkles had already been carved into his face, yet even the depths of each wrinkle had been washed perfectly clean.

units.source_text: 圆脸上惟有鼻子很高，成了流出的树脂凝固起来似的形状。

en.t: On his round face only the nose was very high, shaped like resin that had flowed out and then hardened.

units.source_text: 脸儿虽是这副模样，剃光的头型却很是威严，

en.t: Although his face looked like that, the shape of his shaved head was quite imposing,

units.source_text: 仿佛精力都凝聚在头上，谁有头部才是最具动物特征的。

en.t: as if all his vitality had gathered in his head, and the head itself was the part that carried the strongest animal quality.
